title: Normalized derived endpoint of the closure root line
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite intermediate field in its fixed padic algebraic closure, and X a scheme with ell invertible in global sections. There is an adjoint-normalized Endpoint [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints] from the rational root line spRationalTwist X ell E to the closure root line spQbarTwist X ell along the actual closure coefficient inclusion, whose prescribed underlying map is closureLineMap [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-maps]. This statement contains no direct image or restriction square.

source.place: paragraph (2), the bounded filtered-colimit comparison on a single shifted rational line

proof.text: Use the ordinary normalized closure-line isomorphism. Rational rank-one local freeness implies flatness: its signed dual is an inverse tensor equivalence, and the internal/section module comparison transports exactness. Apply the flat single-complex scalar endpoint, then the single image of the ordinary isomorphism. Naturality of the scalar adjunction and restriction/single comparison gives exactly the prescribed Endpoint normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalClosure_lineEndpoint (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤))) :
    Nonempty (Endpoint (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl l E)
      (spRationalTwist X l E) (spQbarTwist X l) (closureLineMap l E X))
